problem: Texel-buffer emulation emitted transfers during a render pass, triggering Metal encoder validation failures.
change: Collect used texel mirrors per command buffer and copy them before the legacy queue submission, outside render passes. Keep attachment backing non-transient.
validation: Loading panel rendered with Metal API Validation enabled; no encoder assertion during the 60-second test. Menu and gameplay remain unverified.
scope: Wanderer only. GPU-written sources within the same guest command buffer and QueueSubmit2 are not covered by this workaround.
